maddeler.e:
احتضرا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَضَرَا (iḥtaḍarā) /iħ.ta.dˤa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# اُحْتُضِرَا (uḥtuḍirā) /uħ.tu.dˤi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
# اِحْتَضِرَا (iḥtaḍirā) /iħ.ta.dˤi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
